positioning.foundingStory: In July of 1980, Bee Cave Drilling (then known as R&L Pump Service) began in the back room of Rex and Lois Bible’s house in Bee Cave, Texas. Rex grew up in a family of water well drillers and trained under Buster Enochs. By 1986, Rex had saved up enough money to finance a drilling rig and changed the name of the company to Bee Cave Drilling to reflect his expanded services. The company remained a “mom and pop operation” with Rex in the field and Lois in the office with an occasional summer employee until 1993 when Jim Blair joined the staff full-time.
